products.title: History Making Timeless No Gi by Rafael Lovato
products.body:
Master the art of no-gi jiu-jitsu with a system built on precision, pressure, and longevity. In History-Making Timeless No-Gi, Rafael Lovato Jr. reveals the techniques and principles that have defined his championship career — distilled into a streamlined, 4.5-hour instructional designed to elevate every part of your game.

  • This series isn’t about flashy tricks. It’s about high-percentage, battle-tested jiu-jitsu that works against any opponent, at any speed, and at any stage of your training journey

  • Lovato’s timeless approach ties everything together: takedowns, transitions, passing, top control, and submissions — all connected into a clean, repeatable system you can rely on.

  • Whether you’re building your first no-gi foundation or adding depth to an already advanced game, this course gives you the roadmap to roll smarter, stronger, and more efficiently.

What Will You Learn?

Master the art of no-gi jiu-jitsu with a system built on precision, pressure, and longevity. In History-Making Timeless No-Gi, Rafael Lovato Jr. reveals the techniques and principles that have defined his championship career — distilled into a streamlined, 4.5-hour instructional designed to elevate every part of your game.

This series isn’t about flashy tricks. It’s about high-percentage, battle-tested jiu-jitsu that works against any opponent, at any speed, and at any stage of your training journey. Lovato’s timeless approach ties everything together: takedowns, transitions, passing, top control, and submissions — all connected into a clean, repeatable system you can rely on.

Whether you’re building your first no-gi foundation or adding depth to an already advanced game, this course gives you the roadmap to roll smarter, stronger, and more efficiently.

Key Benefits & Features

A Complete No-Gi System

  • Step-by-step instruction covering takedowns, guard passing, top pressure, and finishing sequences

  • A cohesive progression where every position leads naturally to the next

  • Designed for both hobbyists and serious competitors

High-Percentage Takedowns

  • Wrestling-inspired entries that prioritize control over athleticism

  • Clean setups for singles, knee taps, drags, and head-control attacks

  • Strategies for bringing the fight to the ground safely and reliably

Dominant Passing & Top Control

  • Body-lock, knee-cut, smash-pass, and knee-shield-breaking systems

  • Techniques for shutting down guard retention and forcing predictable reactions

  • Pressure-focused style perfect for all body types and experience levels

Submission Chains That Finish

  • Arm triangles, neck-ties, mounted submissions, and front-headlock finishes

  • Sequences that create constant threat and force decisive openings

  • Methods for maintaining control and submitting with minimal wasted energy

Built for Longevity

  • A technical framework meant to grow with you long-term

  • Emphasis on timing, structure, and leverage over strength or explosiveness

  • Ideal for practitioners who want sustainable, intelligent jiu-jitsu

products.title: Timeless Open Guard Foundations by Rafael Lovato
products.body:
Master Legendary Open Guard Strategies with BJJ Pioneer and Undefeated MMA Champion Rafael Lovato Jr.
  • Rafael Lovato Jr. has been competing in BJJ for over 20 years and is one of the most accomplished American Back Belts in the history of the sport, claiming IBJJF world titles in gi and no gi, Brazilian Nationals Gold (first American to do so), and he boasts an undefeated MMA record (Bellator 10-0)
  • Using only 3 gripping configurations Lovato Jr. will help you revolutionize your entire open guard game
  • Learn to position your legs properly, neutralize the passer, and launch attacks from the open guard that Lovato Jr. has been using at the highest levels of the sport for two decades .

Develop A More Balanced Game Plan With the Perfect Blend Of Submission Offense And Sweeps !

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Rafael Lovato Jr. has been successfully competing at the highest levels of jiu-jitsu for over 20 years, earning the highest honors in the BJJ community, including multiple IBJJF World Titles. He cemented himself in BJJ history after becoming the first American to win the Brazilian nationals in 2007 and from there the accomplishments kept coming. Lovato Jr. is also an undefeated MMA Champion, earning a Bellator title with a squeaky clean record of 10-0. A true pioneer of the art and sport, Lovato now shares his secrets to success with the masses through his instructional content, and with Timeless Open Guard Foundations, he’s assembled an incredibly user-friendly guide to dominating from the open guard. With themes Lovato Jr. has relied upon for two decades, you’ll be learning the same skills that helped him develop an incredibly strong open guard that's responsible for the taming of some of the greatest guard passers in the sport! 

Using only 3 gripping variations; the collar and sleeve, two on one, and spider guard grips, Lovato will completely transform the way you approach the open guard and revolutionize your bottom game! Using the perfect blend of sweeps and submissions, Lovato Jr. will guide you as you master one of his most preferred guards and the world-class techniques that he's been relying on for two decades to dominate at the highest levels of the sport!

Build a timeless open guard foundation that will withstand the test of time. Lovato Jr. has been successfully using these techniques at the highest levels for years and he knows exactly how to help you build a bottom game that's trustworthy, dangerous, and efficient!

products.title: Timeless No Gi Headquarters Passing by Rafael Lovato
products.body:
Rafael breaks down how to use each pass to build your arsenal and start adding staples, side smashes, and more to create the best possible top game

  • Use the ultra-effective headquarters position to shut down their offense and begin setting up your own.
  • Attack the guard with knee slices, X passes, leg drags, and more, all optimized for no-gi grappling success.
  • The headquarters position helps you hunt submissions as you combine passing and pressure for maximum potential.
  • Rafael Lovato Jr. is one of the best black belts of his generation, winning world championships in gi & no-gi grappling as well as Bellator MMA’s middleweight division.
  • Rafael breaks down how to use each pass to build your arsenal and start adding staples, side smashes, and more to create the best possible top game.

Pass And Slice Through Guards With Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & MMA World Champion Rafael Lovato Jr.’s Roadmap For Headquarters Passing That He Uses To Flow & Smash To Dominant Positions


 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Use one of the most effective and timeless passing systems in no-gi grappling with BJJ & MMA World Champion Rafael Lovato Jr.’s series on headquarters passing. This 4-part series will give you Rafael’s battle-tested blueprint for attacking the guard and staying in control as you slice and smash to dominant positions.

The headquarters position, Rafael’s go-to when he competes, is a safe position to begin launching high percentage passing from, and now you can learn exactly how Rafael is controlling the headquarters and what you can do to begin passing with the same techniques. Use knee slices, x-passes, toreando, and more, all made to work together in one system.

Rafael Lovato Jr. is one of the best black belts of his generation, with multiple world championships in Brazilian jiu-jitsu and submission grappling, as well as an undefeated world championship run in MMA. He can help show you the same details and techniques that helped set him apart from the competition with these lessons in his signature headquarters passing.

Truly begin attacking the guard with passing attempts combined with submission threats, as Rafael shows you how to add in darces, arm locks, and more as you pressure, pass, and flow. Get these timeless concepts and tips from Rafael as he brings you through some of the most effective moves he knows to pass the guard, using the headquarters system!
